### B-4. Funds Flow — Wire Confirmation Protocol

1. **T-3 Business Days:** Circulate draft Funds Flow Memorandum to all parties for review and comment.
2. **T-2 Business Days:** Confirm all wire instructions in writing with each receiving institution. No wire instruction changes accepted via email alone — all changes require verbal confirmation by a named officer of the receiving institution plus written re-confirmation.
3. **T-1 Business Day:** Final Funds Flow Memorandum approved and executed by CFO of Acquiror and Target. Escrow Agreement funding amounts confirmed with Escrow Agent.
4. **Closing Day Morning:** Acquiror/Sponsor equity contribution wired first. Lender funding notice submitted no later than [●] a.m. Funds to Paying Agent wired only after confirmation of all debt payoff wire receipts.
5. **Post-Wire:** Confirm receipt of funds by each recipient. Paying Agent confirms receipt of Aggregate Merger Consideration before Acquiror or Merger Sub delivers closing certificates to Target.

## PART C — BRING-DOWN CERTIFICATE PACKAGE

### C-1. Bring-Down Principles

At Closing, each party must certify that its representations and warranties remain true and correct as of the Closing Date (with the applicable standard — typically "in all material respects" or "in all respects" for Fundamental Reps), and that all covenants and agreements required to be performed by it at or prior to Closing have been performed in all material respects.

---

### C-2. Target / Seller Bring-Down Certificate

The undersigned, [Name], [Title] of [Target Corporation], a [●] corporation (the "Company"), hereby certifies in connection with the closing of the transactions contemplated by the [Agreement and Plan of Merger / Stock Purchase Agreement / Asset Purchase Agreement], dated as of [●], 2026 (the "Agreement"), among [Acquiror], [Merger Sub / Buyer], and the Company, as follows:

**1. Accuracy of Representations and Warranties**

(a) **Fundamental Representations.** Each of the representations and warranties of the Company and/or the Sellers set forth in Sections [●] (Organization and Good Standing), [●] (Authorization and Enforceability), [●] (Capitalization), [●] (Subsidiaries), [●] (Brokers' Fees), and [●] (Tax Status — if applicable) (collectively, the "Fundamental Representations") was true and correct in all respects as of the date of the Agreement and is true and correct in all respects as of the Closing Date, as if made on and as of the Closing Date (except for representations and warranties expressly made as of an earlier date, which are true and correct in all respects as of such date).

(b) **Non-Fundamental Representations.** Each of the other representations and warranties of the Company and/or the Sellers set forth in Article [●] of the Agreement (other than the Fundamental Representations) was true and correct as of the date of the Agreement and is true and correct as of the Closing Date, as if made on and as of the Closing Date (except for representations and warranties expressly made as of an earlier date, which are true and correct in all respects as of such date), except where the failure of such representations and warranties to be so true and correct (without giving effect to any "materiality" or "Material Adverse Effect" qualifications contained therein) does not constitute and would not reasonably be expected to constitute, individually or in the aggregate, a Material Adverse Effect.

**2. Performance of Covenants**

Each of the covenants and agreements required by the Agreement to be performed or complied with by the Company and/or the Sellers at or prior to the Closing Date has been performed or complied with in all material respects.

**3. No Material Adverse Effect**

Since the date of the Agreement, there has not occurred any Material Adverse Effect with respect to the Company and its Subsidiaries, taken as a whole.

**4. Conditions Satisfied**

All conditions set forth in [Section ●] of the Agreement that are required to be satisfied by the Company and/or the Sellers prior to Closing have been satisfied (or are being satisfied concurrently with the Closing).

**5. Capitalized Terms**

Capitalized terms used but not defined herein have the meanings ascribed to them in the Agreement.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned has executed this certificate as of [Closing Date].

___________________________________
[Name]
[Title]
[Target Corporation]
